[SWS_CORE_15003] Startup and initialization of ARA
⌈
The ara::-
core::Initialize function shall initiate the start-up of the ARA framework, which
might include (but is not limited to): • initialization of ARA framework specific data structures
• initialization of system resources
• spawning of background threads
